## Question

What is the magnitude of the electric field at the dot?

## Answer choices

- A: A: 10kV/m

- B: B: 15kV/m

- C: C: 25kV/m

- D: D: 20kV/m

## Figure caption (auxiliary; use the image as primary evidence)

The image is a 2D coordinate plane with axes labeled \(x\) and \(y\). There is a right triangle formed along these axes with each leg measuring 1 cm, and an angle of 45° at the intersection. Dashed green lines run diagonally, parallel to the hypotenuse of the triangle.

The diagonal lines represent equipotential lines, labeled with electric potentials:

- One line is labeled \(200 \, \text{V}\).
- One line is labeled \(0 \, \text{V}\).
- One line is labeled \(-200 \, \text{V}\).

There is a black dot located centrally among these lines, indicating a specific point in the coordinate system.
